name: TTS Tier Routing Collapse — Quality (Calibration)
description: Calibration recipe for quality-aware TTS routing. Extends T40-C by combining two teacher signals: readability complexity (synth_teacher_readability) and sentiment polarity (synth_teacher_sentiment). Transcripts with high complexity AND strong sentiment signal (positive or negative) route to bonfyre-narrate --verify --refine (quality tier). Neutral low-complexity text routes to fast tier. The combined signal produces a 2-stage routing head: Stage 1 readability tags become a complexity label; Stage 2 sentiment score enriches the embed-level signal by appending sentiment logits to the embedding (done inline in collapse_train via the risk-score task which already handles 2-signal fusion). The trained head is used in the TTS ladder: T40→T41 if text is complex+emotive.
